title: Task list
description: list_all and list_trash (hlm list, hlm trash): the tasks as `result`. list_all also gives `total` (all matches) and `nextCursor` (the next page, or null on the last one).

nextCursor.description: list_all only: pass as cursor for the next page; null when this is the last page

total.description: list_all only: number of matching tasks on all pages
